purpose: Propagate the calibrated satellite membership and stellar-mass likelihood through explicit off-center geometry on the four RX J2129 dynamics radii.
disclosure: The 66-candidate inner ledger, classifier validation metrics, retained membership bootstrap, previously reported nominal mass sums, and one very low-mass candidate inside 5 arcsec were known before this freeze. No satellite force, covariance, Plummer-scale sensitivity, or outer-candidate tidal bound had been evaluated.

geometry.force_quantity: Differential acceleration at each ring point relative to the BCG center, projected onto the inward radial direction. A constant external acceleration cancels.
geometry.line_of_sight_rule: Set line-of-sight separation to zero, maximizing the force at fixed projected separation; report this as a conservative projected-plane likelihood.

monte_carlo.membership_rule: Select one of the 500 correlated classifier-bootstrap probability vectors, then draw Bernoulli membership for each galaxy; spectroscopic 0/1 columns remain exact.
monte_carlo.mass_rule: Draw independent log10 stellar masses from the catalog value with sigma 0.30 dex for selected members.

outer_tidal_bound.rule: For every frozen candidate beyond 30 arcsec, set membership to one and mass to the +0.30-dex value, then sum the point-mass differential tidal bound 2*G*M*r/(R-r)^3 in each bin.
